input: Call the insurance company about the roof claim

gold.taskTitle: Call Insurance Company About Roof Claim
gold.taskDescription: Contact the insurance company to handle or follow up on a roof damage claim.

questions.title: Have you already filed the claim, or not yet?
questions.description: Determine whether this call is to open a new claim or follow up on an existing one.

questions.title: What caused the roof damage?
questions.description: Identify the type of damage event, such as storm, hail, fallen tree, or leak.

questions.title: What is your insurance company's name?
questions.description: Know which insurer to contact so the right phone number and account details can be prepared.

questions.title: Do you have your policy number and claim number ready?
questions.description: Confirm whether key reference numbers are on hand before the call.

questions.title: What specific outcome do you need from this call?
questions.description: Clarify the goal, such as getting a payout status, scheduling an adjuster visit, or disputing a decision.

questions.title: Is there a deadline driving when this call must happen?
questions.description: Determine if there is a filing deadline, contractor start date, or claim expiry creating urgency.

questions.title: Do you have documentation of the damage ready to reference?
questions.description: Check whether photos, repair estimates, or contractor reports are available to support the call.
